procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (59 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-61 monotonic; label 27 is printed '?27.' at the start of the line after q26 (pdf 18) — not a gap. Answer side 1-20, [match block], 22-60; q61 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 39, average 10, difficult 12, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 16 (heading) 17 (LO, q1-10) 18-20; A pdf 121 (heading, keys 1-15) 122-126.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-10; s2 fill q11-15; s3 T/F q16-20; s4 '21. Match the parts of the plant with their functions (easy)' q21; s5 one mark q22-30 vsa; s6 two marks q31-40 sa; s7 three marks q41-50 sa; s8 four marks q51-61 la.

q26/q27: pdf 18 prints '26. What conserves the soil particlesand water?' then a line '?27. Name the root vegetables…' — the stray '?' at the start of q27's line is residue of q26 (not stored); q27 split out and keyed by its own printed number (key 27). 'particlesand' kept as printed.
T/F stems end with a dash answer space ' –' — removed from text, kept in text_as_printed.
Answer-side headings print '(Easy – 1 Mark Each)' — ignored for marks (v2 §2).
q61 'Draw the picture of a plant, colour it and label the parts.' — no key -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_04.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
